channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Tim Hardaway Jr | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Tim Hardaway Jr from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon, Tim Hardaway, Tobias Harris, Tim Hardaway Jr, Malik Beasley, Paul Reed
item.description:
“Tobias Harris, whom I've known for a long time. We've got Malik Beasley, Tim Hardaway Jr, and Paul Reed coming in. I feel very good about the offseason with the veterans. I think Trajan Langdon did a good job bringing the right people in, but still keeping flexibility.”

Tom Gores on Trajan Langdon, Tim Hardaway, Tobias Harris, Tim Hardaway Jr, Malik Beasley, Paul Reed, Oct 9, 2024. Source: Detroit News.

item.title: Rick Carlisle on Tim Hardaway Jr
item.description:
Tim MacMahon:Rick Carlisle on Tim Hardaway Jr., who has emerged as a potent third option for the Mavs:

“I just love the way he plays. He goes hard. He cares about winning. He’s one of our leaders. He’s had a great year. ... He’s about the right stuff. He’s a culture guy.”

Rick Carlisle on Tim Hardaway Jr, Feb 25, 2020. Source: Twitter @espn_macmahon.

item.title: Latrell Sprewell on Tim Hardaway Jr
item.description:
Diamond Leung:Latrell Sprewell on Tim Hardaway Jr.:

“Just to see him now playing as well as he is is a treat for me. He was such a little guy when I first met him, so I root for him a lot.”

Latrell Sprewell on Tim Hardaway Jr, Apr 7, 2018. Source: Twitter @diamond83.

item.title: Glen Grunwald on Tim Hardaway Jr
item.description:
#Knicks GMGlen Grunwald on Tim Hardaway Jr.:

“We were impressed with his shooting, his athleticism and his overall demeanor.”

Glen Grunwald on Tim Hardaway Jr, Jun 27, 2013. Source: Twitter.
